name: chronoflow
description: Todo app and time tracker with Jira integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --handle-input -n main,renderer "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
### ChronoFlow v0.1.17

#### Highlights
- **Day timeline with visible gaps:** every time entry is now a coloured block on a 24h ribbon. Untracked stretches show up as hatched gaps you can hover (duration shown) and click to add an entry pre-filled with that exact time range. Overlapping entries stack in lanes and a live now-marker tracks the running timer.
- **Colour per issue:** every issue gets its own accent colour, auto-derived from the issue id and overridable with a colour picker in the issue form. The colour is consistent across the dashboard, timeline, issue list and timesheets.
- **Whole-app visual redesign:** refreshed colour system (light + dark), ambient background, shared card/button/input styles, consistent page headers, and a redesigned sidebar and title bar. A live timer pill is now visible on every page.
- **Dashboard rework:** two-column workspace (timer + timeline + entries on the left, stats + week overview on the right). Stats show progress against your daily goal and the week overview makes per-day gaps readable at a glance.

#### Also in this release
- Date picker in the manual time entry dialog; the entry list title and empty state now show the selected day (e.g. Today / Yesterday).
- Saving a time entry navigates the dashboard to that entry's date automatically.
- Dashboard keyboard shortcuts: Left/Right change day, T = today, S = stop the running timer.

#### Fixes
- Editing a time entry's date now persists correctly.
- Issue creation now returns the real generated id (the UI could previously hold a stale id until reload).
- E2E tests now run against an isolated, freshly-cleared database and no longer touch the developer database.
